rationale: The mechanical read leans bearish — price is below VWAP, the bounce to $15.37 was rejected back under VWAP with three consecutive lower closes and the heaviest recent volume on the downside candle, and the tape is risk-off (SPY -0.72%, VIXY +3.35%) — but entry quality is poor: price sits only 1.5% above session lows, the 80bp spread plus a 5-minute ATR of ~2.6% means noise alone can stop out any properly-sized position, and the -13% gap has no identified catalyst while float data is missing, making short-squeeze risk unquantifiable. I'd rather wait for either a confirmed break-and-hold below $14.73 (continuation short) or a failed VWAP retest before committing capital.
